title: Time Clauses
ringkas: when, while, before, after, as soon as, until, dan tense setelahnya
goals: memakai **when, while, before, after, as soon as, until** untuk menghubungkan kejadian
memakai **present simple** setelah kata waktu saat membicarakan masa depan
memakai **past simple** dan **past perfect** setelah kata waktu di masa lampau
menyusun urutan kejadian dengan tense yang konsisten

lesson.text: **Klausa waktu** (time clause) diawali kata seperti *when, while, before, after, as soon as, until*. Ada satu aturan penting: untuk masa depan, kata kerja setelah kata waktu memakai **present** (bukan will).

lesson.title: 1. Masa depan: present setelah kata waktu
table: ~~When I will arrive, I will call you.~~
[[When I arrive, I will call you.]]
~~I will wait until she will come.~~
~~After I will finish, I will rest.~~

examples.en: [[As soon as it stops raining, we will go out.]]
examples.id: Begitu hujan berhenti, kita akan keluar.

lesson.title: 2. Masa lampau: urutan kejadian
table: [[When I arrived, she left.]] (aku tiba dulu, lalu dia pergi)
[[When I arrived, she had left.]] (dia sudah pergi sebelum aku tiba)
[[While I was cooking, he was reading.]]
[[While I was cooking, the phone rang.]]

lesson.title: 3. Arti kata penghubung
table: [[Before I leave, I lock the door.]]
[[After I eat, I wash the dishes.]]
[[As soon as I arrive, I'll call.]]

lesson.title: 4. Kebiasaan
lesson.text: Untuk kebiasaan, kedua klausa memakai present simple:
table: Setiap kali hujan, aku di rumah.
[[Before I sleep, I read a book.]]

lesson.title: Koma
lesson.text: Jika klausa waktu di awal kalimat, beri koma: [[When I arrive, I'll call.]] Jika di belakang, tanpa koma: [[I'll call when I arrive.]]

Anna: Apa yang akan kamu lakukan ketika rapat selesai?
Budi: Begitu rapat selesai, aku akan menelepon kakakku.
Anna: Aku akan menunggu sampai kamu selesai.
Budi: Terima kasih. Sebelum meninggalkan kantor, aku selalu mengunci mejaku.
Anna: Ketika aku sampai di sini pagi ini, kamu sudah berangkat ke bandara.
Budi: Ya, sementara aku menunggu di gerbang, aku sadar aku lupa membawa paspor!

qs.q: While I ___ at the gate, I realized I had forgotten my passport.
When I got here, you ___ already left.

qs.answer: I will wait until you finish.
qs.exp: Urutan: I will wait until you finish.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Aku akan menunggu sampai kamu selesai."

read.text:
Anna: What will you do when the meeting ends?
Budi: As soon as it ends, I will call my sister.
Anna: I will wait until you finish.
Budi: Thanks. Before I leave the office, I always lock my desk.
Anna: When I got here this morning, you had already left for the airport.
Budi: Yes, while I was waiting at the gate, I realized I had forgotten my passport!
read.title: Plans After the Meeting

read.id: Sebelum meninggalkan rumah, periksa jendela. Ketika kamu mengunci pintu, bawa kuncinya. Kalau kamu tiba lebih awal, tunggu sampai penjaga membuka gerbang. Begitu kamu masuk, teleponlah aku. Setelah kamu menyelesaikan pekerjaan, kirimi aku pesan. Selama kamu bepergian, jaga ponselmu tetap terisi. Aku akan menunggu di sini sampai kamu menelepon.

read.text: Before you leave the house, check the windows. When you lock the door, take the key with you. If you arrive early, wait until the guard opens the gate. As soon as you get inside, call me. After you finish your work, send me a message. While you are traveling, keep your phone charged. I will wait here until you call.
read.title: Before You Leave

read.id:
Mother: Ketika tamu tiba, tawarkan mereka teh.
Rani: Baik. Apa yang harus kulakukan sebelum mereka datang?
Mother: Sebelum mereka datang, bersihkan ruang tamu. Setelah kamu selesai, tata meja.
Rani: Dan sementara mereka makan, apa yang akan Ibu lakukan?
Mother: Ibu akan sedang berbincang dengan mereka. Begitu mereka pergi, kita akan mencuci piring bersama.
Rani: Aku akan menunggu sampai mereka pergi.

read.text:
Mother: When the guests arrive, offer them some tea.
Rani: OK. What should I do before they come?
Mother: Before they come, clean the living room. After you finish, set the table.
Rani: And while they are eating, what will you do?
Mother: I'll be talking with them. As soon as they leave, we will wash the dishes together.
Rani: I'll wait until they go.
read.title: When the Guests Arrive
